verdict.rationale: Floot turns plain-language descriptions into deployed full-stack apps, and the docs describe delegating work to an assistant. You can point at an element or annotate a screenshot for it, ask it to build an integration's endpoints, tables and screens, ask it to restore a checkpoint, or say "make this a mobile app." However, much of the documentation centres on driving Floot from external AI chats (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) over MCP, so it is not always clear which features belong to the built-in in-product assistant. Missing for 10: clear first-party documentation of the in-editor assistant's scope and workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
